description: Election Commission - B.M.C,D Herath Wickramasinghe was Selected as the Member of the Kuliyapitiya Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local government body (Kuliyapitiya Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for replacing a member who ceased to belong to their political party, including the nomination by a party secretary and the official declaration by the Returning Officer. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and declarations, making it a Type 7 (Elections) gazette.
